title: Conditionals (If… will / would / would have) + hedging
summary: جمل «لو» بأنواعها التلاتة، وإزاي نكتب كلام حذر ومحايد (hedging) من غير مبالغة في الـ JRE.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: **Conditionals** are sentences with **if**. They show what happens, or what would happen, when something else is true. **Hedging** means using careful words (may, might, could, suggest…) so that a claim is not too strong.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن حاجتين مرتبطين ببعض: جمل **«لو» (if)**، و**الكلام الحذر (hedging)**، يعني إنك تقول رأيك من غير ما تبالغ أو تعمّم.

في الكتاب: **Unit 1 : Living Well in a Complex World**. الـ hedging بييجي في **Media Analysis** (صفحة 17) وفي جدول **persuasive writing techniques** (صفحة 19)، والـ conditionals في جزء **Conditional Structures (Hedging)** (صفحة 34-35)، وبعدها في **Consolidation Review A**. الكتاب بيقول إن الكتابة الأكاديمية محتاجة **precision** (دقة) و**caution** (حذر) و**clarity** (وضوح)، والـ conditionals بتساعدك تعبّر عن **اليقين أو الاحتمال أو الحذر**، ودي مهارة مهمة في الـ **JRE**.
الفكرة ببساطة: شرط ← نتيجة

text: Every conditional has two parts: the **if-clause** (the condition) and the **main clause** (the result).

blocks.text: أي جملة شرطية ليها جزئين: **جزء الشرط** (اللي فيه if = لو) و**جزء النتيجة** (اللي هيحصل). زي ما تقول بالعربي: «**لو** ذاكرت، **هتنجح**».

items.en: **If** teenagers exercise regularly, **they will feel more energetic**.
items.ar: الشرط: لو المراهقين اتمرنوا بانتظام. النتيجة: هيحسوا بنشاط أكتر.

items.en: **They will feel more energetic** if teenagers exercise regularly.
items.ar: نفس المعنى. لما الـ if تيجي في **النص**، **مفيش فاصلة**.

blocks.title: قاعدة الفاصلة
blocks.text: لو جملة **if** جت **في الأول** حط **فاصلة** قبل النتيجة. لو جت **في الآخر** مفيش فاصلة.
الأنواع الأربعة

text: The book teaches three types: **first** (real), **second** (hypothetical) and **third** (unreal past). The **zero** conditional (general facts) is useful too.

rows: If schools **offer** counselling, stress levels **may fall**.
If more schools **offered** counselling, students **would feel** better supported.
**would have / could have / might have** + V3
If the study **had included** more schools, the findings **would have been** more conclusive.

blocks.text: خلي بالك من حاجة مهمة: في النوع التاني، الفعل **ماضي** بس المعنى **مش ماضي**. معناه «لو، بس الحقيقة مش كده». وفي النوع التالت الكلام **عن الماضي فعلًا**، وعن حاجة **ماحصلتش**.
كل نوع بالتفصيل
**1) First conditional = حاجة ممكن تحصل (real)**

text: If + present simple, will / may / might / can + base verb.

blocks.text: الشرط ممكن جدًا يتحقق. **ممنوع will بعد if**. وفي الكتابة الأكاديمية الكتاب بيفضّل **may / might / could** بدل will، علشان مبنبقاش متأكدين 100% (ده hedging).

items.en: If students **sleep** eight hours, they **will concentrate** better.
items.ar: متأكد شوية: will.

items.en: If students **sleep** eight hours, they **may concentrate** better.
items.ar: حذر أكتر: may = ممكن. ده أحسن في الكتابة الأكاديمية.

items.en: If you **reduce** screen time, you **might notice** a change in your mood.
items.ar: might = احتمال أضعف.

blocks.text: **2) Second conditional = حاجة خيالية أو بعيدة (hypothetical)**

text: If + past simple, would / could / might + base verb. With **be**, we use **were** for all subjects in formal English.

blocks.text: بنتخيل موقف مش حقيقي دلوقتي. مع فعل **be** بنقول **were** حتى مع I / he / she / it (في الإنجليزي الرسمي).

items.en: If social media **were** less popular, teenagers **would feel** less pressure.
items.ar: بس الحقيقة إن السوشيال ميديا منتشرة جدًا. were مع social media (مفرد).

items.en: If I **were** the head teacher, I **would start** a mindfulness club.
items.ar: أنا مش المدير، ده تخيّل. «If I were you» نصيحة مشهورة.

items.en: If every school **had** a nutritionist, students **would most likely eat** better.
items.ar: most likely = غالبًا. ده hedging جوه الـ second conditional، زي مثال الكتاب.

blocks.text: **3) Third conditional = حاجة ماحصلتش في الماضي (unreal past)**

text: If + had + past participle, would have / could have / might have + past participle.

blocks.text: بنتكلم عن الماضي وبنغيّره في خيالنا. مفيد جدًا علشان **ننقد دراسة** أو نقول **«لو كان حصل كذا»**.

items.en: If schools **had offered** health support earlier, fewer students **would have suffered** from stress.
items.ar: المدارس **ماقدمتش** الدعم بدري، فطلبة كتير عانوا.

items.en: If the researchers **had asked** more teenagers, the results **might have been** different.
items.ar: نقد للدراسة: عيّنة صغيرة. might have = يمكن كان.

items.en: If Nadia **hadn't edited** the photo, it **would have shown** the real café.
items.ar: النفي: hadn't + V3.

blocks.text: كلمات تانية بتعمل شرط

text: **Unless** = if not. **As long as / provided that** = only if. **In case** = to be ready for something that may happen.

rows: **Unless** you sleep well, you will feel tired. = **If you don't** sleep well…
Gaming is fine **as long as** it doesn't replace sleep.
Screens can help learning, **provided that** students take breaks.
Take water **in case** you get thirsty.

blocks.title: خلي بالك من unless
blocks.text: unless **فيها النفي جواها**. ✗ Unless you **don't** exercise… ← ✓ Unless you exercise… (يعني لو ماتمرنتش)
يعني إيه Hedging؟

text: **Hedging** is using cautious language to show that a claim is possible or likely, not 100% certain. It makes writing **neutral**, fair and academic. The opposite is **absolute language** (all, always, never, completely, everyone).

blocks.text: تخيل حد بيقولك: «**كل** المراهقين مدمنين سوشيال ميديا». ده كلام **مبالغ فيه** و**biased** (منحاز)، لأن مش كل المراهقين كده. الأحسن تقول: «**بعض** الدراسات **بتقترح** إن **مراهقين كتير** **ممكن** يكونوا بيستخدموها زيادة». ده هو الـ **hedging**: إنك تحمي كلامك من المبالغة.
الكتاب بيقسّم الكلمات كده: **Absolute words** بتقول الكلام بثقة كاملة. **Hedging words** بتبيّن **uncertainty or caution**. **Neutral language** متوازنة وموضوعية ومن غير تحيّز.

rows: suggest, indicate, imply, appear, seem, tend to
possibly, probably, perhaps, often, usually, generally
some, many, most, a number of, certain types of
Research suggests that… / It is possible that… / There is evidence that…
Everyone knows that… / It is a fact that…

blocks.text: أمثلة: من كلام منحاز ← لكلام حذر ومحايد

items.en: Biased: Gaming **destroys** **all** teenagers' brains.
items.ar: كلام مطلق: destroys + all.

items.en: Hedged: Research **suggests** that **excessive** gaming **may** affect **some** teenagers' concentration.
items.ar: suggests + may + some + excessive (مش أي لعب). كده الكلام محايد.

items.en: Biased: Processed food **always** makes people ill.
items.ar: always مبالغة.

items.en: Hedged: Eating processed food **regularly** **could** increase the risk of some diseases.
items.ar: could + regularly + some.

items.en: Biased: **Everyone** who uses Instagram feels depressed.
items.ar: Everyone تعميم.

items.en: Hedged: **Many** studies **indicate** that heavy Instagram use **is linked to** low mood in **certain** users.
items.ar: Many + indicate + is linked to (مرتبط، مش «بيسبب أكيد»).

items.en: Biased: Mindfulness **completely** cures stress.
items.ar: completely مبالغة.

items.en: Hedged: Mindfulness **appears to** help **many** people manage stress.
items.ar: appears to = يبدو إنه.

items.en: Hedged conditional: If teenagers spend less time online, they **are likely to** sleep better.
items.ar: first conditional + hedging: are likely to بدل will.

items.en: Hedged conditional: If the survey **had included** rural schools, the results **might have been** more reliable.
items.ar: third conditional لنقد الدليل بأدب.

blocks.text: إزاي نستخدمهم في الـ JRE

text: Use hedging in your **claim** and **evidence** to sound fair. Use conditionals to explain **possible results** (first), **suggest solutions** (second) and **evaluate evidence** (third).

rows: Schools **should probably** limit phone use during lessons.
**If** students **are** away from their phones, they **may focus** more deeply.
suggest / indicate + third conditional لتقييم الدليل
One study **suggests** that grades improved, although **if** it **had lasted** longer, it **would have been** more convincing.

blocks.text: فقرة كاملة صغيرة. الـ hedging والـ conditionals مكتوبين bold:

text: **Justify:** Counselling services **could** play an important role in reducing stress at school. **Reason:** **If** students **have** someone to talk to, they **are less likely to** keep their worries to themselves. **Evidence:** A recent survey **indicates** that **many** students who used school counselling felt calmer. However, **if** the survey **had included** more schools, its findings **would have been** more conclusive.

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء (غلط ← صح)
items: ✗ If schools **will offer** counselling, … ← ✓ If schools **offer** counselling, … (ممنوع will بعد if)
✗ If schools offered counselling, students **may felt** … ← ✓ … students **would feel** … (بعد الموديل الفعل مجرد)
✗ If schools **had offer** counselling, … ← ✓ If schools **had offered** … (had + V3)
✗ If schools offer counselling, students **would have felt** better yesterday. ← ✓ If schools **had offered** counselling, students **would have felt** better. (خلّط نوعين)
✗ If the study had included more schools, the results **would be** more conclusive **last year**. ← ✓ … **would have been** more conclusive.
✗ If I **was** you, I **will** sleep earlier. ← ✓ If I **were** you, I **would** sleep earlier.
✗ **All** teenagers **always** waste time online. ← ✓ **Some** teenagers **may** spend **too much** time online. (hedging)

blocks.title: إزاي تجاوب بسرعة في الامتحان
items: بص على الـ **if-clause**: present ← النتيجة **will / may**. past ← **would**. had + V3 ← **would have + V3**.
ولو العكس: لقيت **would have** في النتيجة؟ يبقى الشرط لازم **had + V3**.
كلمة زي **yesterday / last year / earlier** مع if = غالبًا **third conditional**.
في سؤال rewrite the bias: شيل **all / always / never / completely / everyone**، وحط **some / many / may / suggest / often**.

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات بتيجي بالأشكال دي. هنحل مثال لكل شكل:
**1) Only one sentence in each group is grammatically correct. Choose the correct answer.**

text: a. If parents set screen rules, children may sleep better.
b. If parents set screen rules, children would have slept better.
c. If parents had set screen rules, children may slept better.
d. If parents will set screen rules, children sleep better.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: a.** ليه؟ first conditional صح: present + may + base. (b) خلط first مع third. (c) بعد may لازم فعل مجرد، والتالت محتاج would have slept. (d) ممنوع will بعد if.
**2) Complete the sentence with an "if" conditional.**

text: If teenagers had more free time, they ______ (take up) creative hobbies.

blocks.text: **الإجابة:** would take up. ليه؟ had (ماضي) = second conditional ← **would + base**. وممكن تقول **might take up** لو عايز حذر أكتر.
**3) Rewrite this biased sentence using neutral and hedging language.**

text: "Teenagers never listen to advice about healthy eating."

blocks.text: **إجابة نموذجية:** Some teenagers **may not always** follow advice about healthy eating. ليه؟ شلنا never (مطلقة) وحطينا **Some + may + not always**.
تدريب
**A. Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

items.q:
1. If teenagers ______ regularly, they will feel more energetic.
a. exercised  b. exercise  c. will exercise  d. had exercised
items.a: **b. exercise** — النتيجة will ← الشرط present simple (first).

items.q:
2. If every class had a short exercise break, students ______ more alert.
a. will feel  b. feel  c. would feel  d. would have felt
items.a: **c. would feel** — had (past) ← would + base (second).

items.q:
3. If the researchers had followed the students for longer, the results ______ more reliable.
a. would be  b. will be  c. would have been  d. had been
items.a: **c. would have been** — had followed ← would have + V3 (third).

items.q:
4. If I ______ you, I would turn off my phone an hour before bed.
a. am  b. were  c. will be  d. had
items.a: **b. were** — If I were you (نصيحة، second).

items.q:
5. ______ you drink enough water, you will get headaches.
a. If  b. Unless  c. As long as  d. Provided that
items.a: **b. Unless** — = If you don't drink enough water.

items.q:
6. Which word is a hedging word?
a. always  b. completely  c. might  d. everyone
items.a: **c. might** — بتبيّن احتمال وحذر. الباقي كلمات مطلقة (absolute).

items.q:
7. Research ______ that sport can reduce anxiety in some adolescents.
a. proves completely  b. suggests  c. knows  d. destroys
items.a: **b. suggests** — فعل hedging = بتقترح. proves completely مطلقة.

items.q:
8. If Omar hadn't stayed up late, he ______ so tired in the exam.
a. wouldn't feel  b. won't feel  c. wouldn't have felt  d. didn't feel
items.a: **c. wouldn't have felt** — hadn't stayed (third) ← wouldn't have + V3.

blocks.text: **B. Only one sentence in each group is grammatically correct. Choose the correct answer.**

items.q:
9. a. If students sleep well, they may concentrate better.
b. If students will sleep well, they concentrate better.
c. If students slept well, they may concentrated better.
d. If students had sleep well, they would concentrate better.
items.a: **a** — first conditional صح. (b) will بعد if، (c) concentrated بعد may، (d) had sleep لازم had slept.

items.q:
10. a. If the school had built a gym, more students would exercise last year.
b. If the school had built a gym, more students would have exercised.
c. If the school built a gym, more students would have exercised.
d. If the school has built a gym, more students would have exercised.
items.a: **b** — had + V3 ← would have + V3. (a) last year محتاجة would have exercised.

items.q:
11. a. Unless you don't take breaks, your eyes will hurt.
b. Unless you take breaks, your eyes hurt will.
c. Unless you take breaks, your eyes will hurt.
d. Unless you will take breaks, your eyes will hurt.
items.a: **c** — unless فيها النفي، ومن غير will بعدها.

items.q:
12. a. Everyone who plays video games becomes aggressive.
b. All video games make teenagers aggressive.
c. Some research implies that certain violent games could influence aggressive behaviour.
d. Video games always cause aggression.
items.a: **c** — دي الجملة **المحايدة** (hedged): some + implies + certain + could. الباقي مطلق ومنحاز.

blocks.text: **C. Complete with the correct form of the verb in brackets.**

items.q: 13. If you (reduce) your sugar intake, you may notice more energy.
items.a: **reduce** — first conditional: present simple في الشرط.

items.q: 14. If Egyptian cities had more green parks, families (spend) more time outdoors.
items.a: **would spend** — second: had ← would + base.

items.q: 15. If the school had started its healthy-snack campaign earlier, fewer pupils (buy) fizzy drinks.
items.a: **would have bought** — third: had started ← would have + V3.

items.q: 16. If Nadia (not / compare) herself with influencers, she would have felt happier.
items.a: **hadn't compared** — النتيجة would have felt ← الشرط had + V3 (منفي).

items.q: 17. If people (eat) processed food every day, their health may suffer.
items.a: **eat** — first conditional مع may (hedging): present simple في الشرط.

blocks.text: **D. Rewrite and write as asked.**

items.q: 18. Rewrite using neutral and hedging language: "Fast food ruins everyone's health."
items.a: Eating fast food **too often could harm** the health of **many** people. — شلنا ruins و everyone (مطلقة) وحطينا could harm + many + too often.

items.q: 19. Rewrite using neutral and hedging language: "Video games are a complete waste of time."
items.a: Playing video games **for too long may** take time away from **other** useful activities. — شلنا complete waste (حكم مطلق)، وحطينا may + for too long (مش أي لعب).

items.q: 20. Make a third conditional sentence: The researchers asked only 50 students. The results were not reliable.
items.a: If the researchers **had asked** more students, the results **would have been** more reliable. — العكس اللي ماحصلش في الماضي.

items.q: 21. Make a second conditional sentence: Our school doesn't have a nutritionist. Students don't get advice on food.
items.a: If our school **had** a nutritionist, students **would get** advice on food. — الحاضر عكس الحقيقة ← second.

items.q: 22. Write ONE first conditional sentence about mental health at school with a hedging modal.
items.a: مثال: If teachers **notice** signs of stress early, students **may get** help sooner. — present + may.

items.q: 23. Write a short JRE (3 sentences) about sport and well-being. Use one conditional and two hedging words.
items.a: مثال: Regular sport **could** improve teenagers' well-being. If young people **join** a team, they **are likely to** make new friends and feel less lonely. Research **suggests** that physical activity **can** lower stress levels. — J ثم R (conditional) ثم E (suggests).

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: **First:** If + present, **will / may / might** + base ← حاجة ممكن تحصل.
**Second:** If + past (**were**), **would / could** + base ← تخيّل. **Third:** If + **had + V3**, **would have + V3** ← ماضي ماحصلش.
**ممنوع will بعد if**، و**unless = if not** (من غير not تانية).
**Hedging** = may, might, could, suggest, indicate, tend to, likely, some, many… بدل all, always, never, completely, everyone.
في الـ JRE: hedging علشان **تبقى محايد**، والـ conditionals علشان **تشرح نتيجة** أو **تقيّم دليل**.
